sentence_1_it: Questa è una fotografia del mio dipinto.
sentence_1_en: This is a picture of my own painting.
sentence_2_it: Tom pensò che ci fossero buone possibilità che chi aveva rubato il dipinto fosse Maria.
sentence_2_en: Tom thought that there was a good chance that it was Mary who had stolen the painting.
sentence_3_it: Mi piace questo dipinto, non perché è un capolavoro ma perché ha fascino.
sentence_3_en: I like this picture, not because it is a masterpiece, but because it has charm.

sentence_1_en: How many paintings did he make?
sentence_2_en: How many paintings did he make?
sentence_3_it: Dissi a Tom che ero interessato a comprare uno dei suoi dipinti.
sentence_3_en: I told Tom that I was interested in buying one of his paintings.
